HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Treat Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha as rumours only.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)

   A. Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
